title: Fresh Session Guarded Wrapper Expired Approval Probe
claim: A fresh ChatGPT session could invoke the exposed guarded next-gate wrapper, and ForgePilot safely blocked progression because the approval had expired.
summary: Record that forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate was allowed by the ChatGPT host at the PREVIEW_CLEARANCE stage. ForgePilot did not apply the gate because the FP-MCP-331 approval was expired or invalid. No files were written, no approval was consumed, no runner endpoint was contacted, and OpenCode was not started.
caveats: This does not prove the wrapper will be allowed with a fresh valid approval.
This does not reach final guarded execution.
boundaries: ForgePilot rejected progression due to expired approval.
No files written by the wrapper.
observedResult: A fresh ChatGPT session could invoke the exposed guarded next-gate wrapper, and ForgePilot safely blocked progression because the approval had expired.
